reason: A proposes a more physically plausible and directly testable intervention—controlled precipitation aging—with a clear untreated baseline and falsification criteria, whereas B relies on weakly supported claims that a 1–2 T pulsed field will enhance diffusion and generate coherent precipitates at 400–600 K. A still needs a specified alloy chemistry and quantitative mechanical/MCE retention targets, and its domain-wall argument does not directly establish preservation of a first-order magnetocaloric transition, but it is the stronger proposal.
